@codex review

Please review [commit `48379653013dbed6388f9d910851f90d82e97410`](https://github.com/mech-lang/mech/commit/48379653013dbed6388f9d910851f90d82e97410).

Load wide integer constants for AArch64 conditional comparisons from the literal pool. Fold an adjacent CSET inversion when its input has one use and preserve the register branch. The original codec bytecode and disabled-path executable replay exactly.

The Apple M1 run used 81 cases, libdeflate 1.26 at level 12 and 96 balanced blocks per case in each order.
The mean positive slowdown over the fixed 18 cases fell from **4.84576%** to **4.65789%**, an improvement of **0.18787 percentage points**.
The maximum paired gap fell from **22.75011%** to **22.31519%**. The worst-order mean fell from 5.14038% to 4.91800%.

The candidate won **73/81 forward** and **70/81 in reverse**. All 70 protected libdeflate wins and all independent control wins held in both orders. The additional forward wins were `prefix-random-32767`, `prefix-random-32768` and `prefix-random-32769`.

Matched original-source-to-executable medians were **2.20306 s control**, **2.20855 s candidate** and **0.48095 s C**.
Candidate encoder text was 65,208 B, lookup data 3,200 B, whole const 17,728 B, stripped executable 210,024 B and peak stack 4,880 B.

Native checks covered 64,250 comparison calls, 65,536 conditional-set calls, 162 exact codec outputs and aliases, six checked errors, 12 recoveries and 324 linked deployment smoke runs. Checker and spill-inspection replays matched the selected object. Independently validated timing result SHA-256 appears below.

`ee1937bd7edae5db57a66bdd892000d9c2e24afbbc9855d87111f532cdfd0449`
